# Code of Conduct — YT6

YT6 is a clarity benchmark project. All contributors must follow these rules:

## Principles
- respect clarity
- respect reproducibility
- respect determinism
- respect evidence
- respect contributors

## Unacceptable Behaviour
- altering benchmark integrity
- introducing drift intentionally
- modifying datasets without approval
- manipulating scoring
- disrespectful communication

## Enforcement
Violations may result in:
- issue closure
- pull request rejection
- contributor removal
